eyebrow: The T-SQL Development Course · Chapter Four
subtitle: Lesson 40 · Grouping and Aggregating

code:
SELECT p.Color, COUNT(*) AS ProductCount,
  AVG(p.ListPrice) AS AveragePrice,
  MIN(p.ListPrice) AS CheapestPrice,
  MAX(p.ListPrice) AS MostExpensivePrice
FROM Production.Product AS p
WHERE p.Color IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.Color
HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 AND AVG(p.ListPrice) > 50
ORDER BY AveragePrice DESC;
caption: Categories with more than 5 products, averaging over $50, sorted highest first.
